t: You're looking at Tate Modern, the home of the United Kingdom's national collection of international modern and contemporary art. It occupies the former Bankside Power Station, in Bankside, in the London Borough of Southwark. The name comes from Sir Henry Tate, the sugar merchant and philanthropist who established the Tate Gallery and founded Henry Tate and Sons, which later became Tate and Lyle. Tate Modern is one of four galleries in the Tate group, alongside Tate Britain, Tate Liverpool and Tate St Ives.
